title: Magyar nevek
summary: In Hungarian the family name comes first. Married women may add -né to their husband's family name.

sections.text: Hungarian puts the **family name first** and the first name second, in every situation: introductions, forms, books, street signs. *Kis Balázs* is Balázs from the Kis family.
Foreign names keep their own order: *John Peters vagyok.* But a Hungarian who introduces themselves to you will say the family name first, so *Szabó Iván* is Iván.

**-né** means “wife of”. *Kovácsné* = Mrs Kovács. A married woman can be *Kovácsné Radnai Beáta*: husband's family name + **-né**, then her own family and first name. Many younger women simply keep their own name.

items.en: Beáta Radnai, married to Mr Kovács
Anna Kis, married to Mr Nagy

sections.text: Notice: Te **vagy** Kis Balázs? uses vagy, but Ön Kis Balázs? has **no verb**, because Ön works like ő.
